params.weth: Canonical WETH address for the target chain (used for via-WETH routing).

getTwapReference(address,address,uint128.details: Intended for analysis/debug and for cases where direct pools are sufficiently liquid.

params.amountIn: Amount of tokenIn used for quoting (uint128 by design).
params.minLiqRatioBps: Liquidity filter in bps relative to max liquidity among valid pools (0 disables).
params.mode: How to pick the reference quote among pools.

returns.minLiquidity: Absolute min liquidity threshold used for filtering (0 if disabled). Reverts: - TwapSecondsZero, AmountInZero, SameToken, BpsOutOfRange, NoValidPools
returns.poolsFound: Number of valid pools discovered across fee tiers.
returns.refFee: Fee tier of the selected "most reliable" pool (max liquidity within filter; informational).
returns.twapOut: Reference TWAP output amount for amountIn.

getTwapReferenceViaWeth(address,address,.details: - If tokenIn == WETH: single leg WETH -> tokenOut.  - If tokenOut == WETH: single leg tokenIn -> WETH.  - Otherwise: two-leg quote using WETH as a robust intermediate.  This function is intended as the "production" reference for exotica / semi-exotica  when direct pools are missing or too manipulable.

params.amountIn: Amount of tokenIn used for quoting (uint256; safely downcasted per leg).
params.minLiqRatioBps: Liquidity filter in bps relative to max liquidity per leg (0 disables).
params.mode: How to pick the reference quote among pools per leg.

returns.twapOut: Reference TWAP output amount for amountIn via WETH. Reverts: - TwapSecondsZero, AmountInZero, SameToken, BpsOutOfRange, NoValidPools - AmountTooLargeForUint128 if amountIn or intermediate WETH amount doesn't fit uint128.

requireSpotWithinTwap(address,address,ui.details: Use this as a pre-swap / pre-deposit sanity check against short-term manipulation.

params.amountIn: Amount of tokenIn the spotOut corresponds to.
params.maxDeviationBps: Max allowed deviation from TWAP in bps (0..10000).
params.minLiqRatioBps: Liquidity filter in bps relative to max liquidity per leg (0 disables).
params.spotOut: Observed spot output amount (e.g., from router quote / swap preview).

returns.twapOut: Computed TWAP reference output (via WETH). Reverts: - BpsOutOfRange if maxDeviationBps > 10000 - DeviationTooHigh if spotOut is outside [twapOut*(1-dev), twapOut*(1+dev)] - plus any reverts from getTwapReferenceViaWeth
